CustomField.description: Total FOREX component of the tour including discounts, additional cost, optional tour cost. This is in FOREX without conversion to INR and excluding any taxes.
CustomField.formula:
CASE(Room_Type__c, 'Single',((Booking__r.Tour_Plan__r.Single__c + Booking__r.FOREX_Component__c) - Booking__r.FOREX_Component_Reduction__c ),
'Double',((Booking__r.Tour_Plan__r.Double_Tuwin_Triple__c + Booking__r.FOREX_Component__c) - Booking__r.FOREX_Component_Reduction__c ),
'Triple',((Booking__r.Tour_Plan__r.Double_Tuwin_Triple__c + Booking__r.FOREX_Component__c) - Booking__r.FOREX_Component_Reduction__c ),
'Twin',((Booking__r.Tour_Plan__r.Double_Tuwin_Triple__c + Booking__r.FOREX_Component__c) - Booking__r.FOREX_Component_Reduction__c ),
'Child With Bed',(( Booking__r.Tour_Plan__r.Child_With_Bed__c + Booking__r.FOREX_Component__c) - Booking__r.FOREX_Component_Reduction__c ),
'Child Without Bed',(( Booking__r.Tour_Plan__r.Child_Without_Bed__c +Booking__r.FOREX_Component__c) - Booking__r.FOREX_Component_Reduction__c ),0)
CustomField.label: Total FOREX
